changes: No substantive changes; notes expanded on era attribution and on the catalogue's scribe/king fields

notes: The colophon gives a bare 'samvat 804'. It is taken as Nepāla Saṃvat (= 1684 CE) because the script is Newari and the year falls in the reign of the king the catalogue names, (Sumati-)Jitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur (c. 1673–1696). The catalogue also names a scribe, Bhāgirāma Pradhānāṅga, and this king. Neither name appears in the quoted colophon, which only has the standard 'ādarśadoṣā ... lekhakasya' verse. They may be in a part of the manuscript that was not quoted, such as another folio or a cover note. So both have been left out of the person register. If they are confirmed elsewhere, add Bhāgirāma (titles: pradhānāṅga; role: scribe) and Jitāmitra Malla (role: king).
